name: Bazarr+
short_desc: Find and manage subtitles for movies, TV, and sports.
description: Bazarr+ manages subtitles for movie, television, and sports libraries. It can run standalone for manual subtitle workflows or connect to supported media managers. This Runtipi app installs Bazarr+ only and does not provision other services.
author: LavX

form_fields.label: PUID
form_fields.hint: Numeric user ID used by the image entrypoint to run Bazarr+ and own /config. Keep the Compose user unset.

form_fields.label: PGID
form_fields.hint: Numeric group ID used by the image entrypoint for /config and media file access.
